cd /work && cat > cfg/boolparse.py <<'EOF'
"""Boolean parsing for settings."""

_TRUE = {"true", "yes", "on", "1"}
_FALSE = {"false", "no", "off", "0"}


def parse_bool(text):
    """Parse yes/no, on/off, true/false, 1/0 (any case). Raise ValueError otherwise."""
    t = text.strip().lower()
    if t in _TRUE:
        return True
    if t in _FALSE:
        return False
    raise ValueError(text)
EOF
cat > cfg/load.py <<'EOF'
"""Settings precedence: environment > file > defaults."""


def resolve(name, defaults, file_values, env):
    """Value for setting `name`. env keys are APP_<NAME> in upper case."""
    key = "APP_" + name.upper()
    if key in env:
        return env[key]
    if name in file_values:
        return file_values[name]
    return defaults.get(name)
EOF
